# Evidence card — Build a flexible routine

Direct adult evidence is thin, and most routine research is paediatric. Treat this as a design hypothesis.

Use only these claims, within the scope stated. None of them tested this software.

- **CLM-RS-ROUTINE-SCOPING** (checked against an abstract or summary only): A 2026 scoping review of 31 studies (Almudayfir et al., Behavioral Sciences) found that research on daily routines and habits in ADHD is concentrated in paediatric populations, with limited adult research and no validated ADHD-specific routine/habit measure. Routine-support features for adults therefore rest on thin direct evidence.
  Source: [Daily Routines and Habits in Individuals with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder: A Scoping Review](https://doi.org/10.3390/bs16061000).
- **CLM-RS-IMPL-INTENTIONS** (checked against an abstract or summary only): In general-population research, forming if-then plans (implementation intentions) had a medium-to-large average effect on goal attainment across 94 tests (Gollwitzer & Sheeran, 2006, d = .65). This is adjacent evidence for cue-action pairing. It is not ADHD-specific and not evidence for this software.
  Source: [Implementation Intentions and Goal Achievement: A Meta-analysis of Effects and Processes](https://doi.org/10.1016/S0065-2601(06)38002-1).
- **CLM-RS-LIVED** (verified against the source): A 2022 rapid review of 35 qualitative studies (Ginapp et al.) reported that adults with ADHD describe using regular schedules, to-do lists and reminder apps, and being helped by partners, friends, family and workplace reminders. These are self-reported coping strategies, not evidence that they work or that this software helps.
  Source: [The lived experiences of adults with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder: A rapid review of qualitative evidence](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychiatry/articles/10.3389/fpsyt.2022.949321/full).

Full register, statuses and limitations: `evidence/claims.yaml` in the source repository. Runtime snapshot: `references/shared/runtime-evidence.md`. No claim has been reviewed by a clinician.
